title: Kitchen Steamed Filipino Noodles Pancit Canton
description: A traditional Filipino dish featuring steamed noodles, black olives, and a nutty flavor, all wrapped in a leaf and steamed to perfection, making it a great hangover cure.

ingredients.name: leaf wraps
ingredients.notes: such as banana or spinach leaves

instructions: Heat the cooking oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and saute until fragrant.
Add the chopped onion and saute until translucent.
Add the black olives and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Prepare the leaf wraps by washing and drying them.
Place a portion of the noodles in the center of each leaf wrap.
Add a spoonful of the garlic, onion, and olive mixture on top of the noodles.
Sprinkle grated cheese over the top.
Fold the leaf wraps to enclose the filling and place on a salt block.
Steam the pancit canton for 10-12 minutes or until the cheese is melted and the noodles are cooked.
